services.desc: A Giclée (pronounced Gee-Clay) is a digitally reproduced print which looks very close to an original painting. All of Mark's giclees are printed on canvas which help to give them that ‘real painting’ feel plus do not require glass when framed. Mark's giclée reproductions are limited to editions of 50 and he personally numbers and signs each one. Giclées generally come in small, medium or large with the specific size varying from one giclee to another. Please see each individual artworks for size options and prices. Type in any keyword to search giclées.(Medium, Orientation, Year, Location, Theme, etc.) FAQ: Click Here for general information, including Ordering, Shipping, & Return Policies.

blurb: Step into Mark Hobson's world of original art, where each piece tells a unique story of the West Coast of Canada. With watercolour, acrylic, and oil, his work captures the texture and depth of nature. These one-of-a-kind pieces, often started outdoors, bring a genuine touch to your space.
